name: Otanoshimi CD Vol. 1
source:
○ Produced by Nekuromikon "Kirara's First Errand"
The cute lolita girl "Kirara" heads to the apartment where her brother lives.
Hopefully she won't get into any naughty situations...

○ Produced by Bishamon "Fate Rape"
Bishamon, who only produces original games, takes on a parody ADV for the first time.
Set after the Holy Grail War, Tohsaka gets into all sorts of trouble.

Two wallpapers are included in the HTML manual.
The theme is "Rag○roku" female Ako and female Nobi rape wallpapers.

○ The female voices in the two stories are all fully voiced.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050305114255/http://www111.sakura.ne.jp/~game/bisya/natucomi2.html]official website[/url]]
